# svinooh

> Crypto portfolio tracker across EVM, Solana, TRON and Bitcoin. Tokens, LP,
> staking, lending, farming — the DeFi positions other trackers miss, counted
> at full value.

svinooh is a web app at https://svinooh.com. Paste a wallet address to get a
live portfolio for it, or sign in with Telegram or X to combine wallets from
different chains into one portfolio — private by default, shareable by link.

Key facts:

- Tracks 50+ networks, including Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana, Base, Bitcoin,
  OP Mainnet, BNB Chain, Polygon, TRON, Avalanche, Hyperliquid, Berachain,
  Scroll, Linea, zkSync, Blast, Mantle, Sonic, Gnosis, Celo, Mode, Zora, Sei
  and Plasma.
- Counts DeFi positions at full value: wallet tokens, liquidity pools,
  staking, lending and farming — not just token balances.
- Portfolios are private by default. Owners can share one by link or list it
  publicly; nothing about the owner is ever shown.
- Free to use. svinooh Pro is the paid tier: higher limits on portfolios,
  wallets, history, alerts and AI, prepaid by the month.

## Pages

- [Home](https://svinooh.com/): product overview, public portfolios, wallet
  address search
- [Pro](https://svinooh.com/pro): what Pro changes and what it costs
- [FAQ](https://svinooh.com/faq): chains, pricing, freshness, privacy —
  answered plainly
- [Supported chains](https://svinooh.com/chains): the four chain families and
  the EVM network list
- [Solana tracking](https://svinooh.com/chains/solana): DeFi positions across
  ~118 platforms, with ranges and health factors
- [TRON tracking](https://svinooh.com/chains/tron): Stake 2.0 staking, energy
  and bandwidth, delegation alerts
- [Bitcoin tracking](https://svinooh.com/chains/bitcoin): address balances
  counted beside everything else
- [Hyperliquid tracking](https://svinooh.com/chains/hyperliquid): full account
  value — perps margin, spot, staked HYPE, vaults
- [EVM tracking](https://svinooh.com/chains/evm): one address across 60+
  networks — coverage, position shapes, on-chain checks
- Per-network pages: /chains/ethereum, /chains/arbitrum, /chains/base,
  /chains/optimism, /chains/bnb-chain, /chains/polygon, /chains/avalanche,
  /chains/berachain, /chains/zksync, /chains/linea, /chains/scroll,
  /chains/sonic
- [Zapper alternative](https://svinooh.com/alternatives/zapper): where to go
  after the August 2026 shutdown
- [DeBank alternative](https://svinooh.com/alternatives/debank): the same EVM
  picture plus Solana, TRON and Bitcoin
- [Zerion alternative](https://svinooh.com/alternatives/zerion): watch-only
  tracking — no keys, no signatures
- [CoinStats alternative](https://svinooh.com/alternatives/coinstats): the
  on-chain half, counted at full value
